name: Kaddora Appointments – Booking Calendar and Scheduling
author: kaddora

sections.description:
Kaddora Appointments provides a complete appointment-booking workflow for WordPress. Create services, assign staff, configure weekly working hours, publish a booking form, manage appointments, and allow customers to cancel or reschedule eligible bookings.

The free plugin does not expire, impose booking quotas, or require a license key. Optional commercial add-ons are installed separately and extend the free plugin through documented WordPress hooks and filters.

Free features

  • Unlimited services, staff, locations, resources, customers, and appointments.
  • Public booking form and service availability calendar.
  • Staff assignment, weekly schedules, recurring breaks, holidays, buffers, capacity, and slot intervals.
  • Appointment administration with status changes, search, filters, and CSV export.
  • Customer and staff self-service dashboards.
  • Secure cancellation and rescheduling controls.
  • Email confirmations, status notifications, reminders, and scheduled maintenance.
  • Basic dashboard totals and appointment trends.
  • Staff leave requests and approval workflow.
  • WordPress privacy exporter, eraser, retention, and anonymization support.
  • Gutenberg booking block and standard shortcodes.
  • Optional onboarding that creates recommended pages as drafts only.
  • Optional administrator-configured outbound webhooks.

Optional separately distributed add-ons

ThemeKaddora may offer separate add-on plugins for calendar synchronization, authenticated external APIs, online payments, WooCommerce checkout, visual form building, page-builder widgets, and advanced analytics. These add-ons are not required for the free booking workflow.

The free plugin does not contact ThemeKaddora automatically. The Upgrade page opens the product page only after an administrator clicks the link.

How to configure the plugin

  1. Create an appointment service.
  2. Add a staff member and assign one or more services.
  3. Configure default business hours and staff working hours.
  4. Add [kaddora_booking] to a page or insert the booking block.
  5. Submit a test booking and confirm that notification email delivery works.
  6. Configure cancellation, rescheduling, reminders, and data-retention settings as needed.

Shortcodes

1.Dashboard-Appointment command center
2.Calendar-Appointment calendar
3.Appointments
4.Appointment services
5.Staff and schedules
6.Locations
7.Appointment resources
8.Customers
9.Appointment settings
10.Appointment tools
11.Extend Kaddora Appointments

Time zones and scheduled tasks

Appointment dates and times use the WordPress site time zone unless a staff-specific time zone is configured. Reminder and maintenance tasks use WP-Cron, so low-traffic sites may benefit from a real server cron that calls WordPress cron regularly.

Customer and staff access

Customer dashboards require a logged-in WordPress account whose email address matches the booking email. Staff dashboards require a staff record linked to the logged-in WordPress user and the appropriate plugin capability.

Cancellation and rescheduling

Administrators can configure a cutoff period. Eligible customers can cancel or reschedule through secure self-service controls without receiving access to other customers’ bookings.

Data retention

The plugin can anonymize finished appointments after a configured number of days. Permanent database deletion during uninstall is optional and must be enabled by an administrator before uninstalling.

External services

Administrator-configured webhooks

The plugin can send booking-event data to an HTTPS webhook URL configured by a site administrator.

The webhook is contacted only when an administrator enters an HTTPS endpoint and explicitly enables the feature. Depending on the event, transmitted information may include the appointment reference, service, staff identifier, customer name, customer email address, customer telephone number, appointment date and time, booking status, quantity, price, currency, and event metadata.

Sensitive booking-management tokens, cancellation tokens, rescheduling tokens, payment tokens, API credentials, OAuth credentials, webhook secrets, and similar authentication values are excluded from the payload.

The destination service and its privacy practices are selected and controlled by the site administrator, so there is no single third-party privacy policy or terms URL that applies to every configured webhook.

ThemeKaddora product page

The plugin does not contact ThemeKaddora automatically. When an administrator clicks an Upgrade link, the browser opens:
https://themekaddora.com/items/kaddora-appointments-booking-calendar-and-scheduling/1060

No booking or customer data is transmitted by the plugin when displaying the Upgrade page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Kaddora Appointments.
  3. Create at least one service and one staff member.
  4. Configure business hours and staff availability.
  5. Add [kaddora_booking] to a page or use the booking block.
  6. Submit a test booking before opening the form to customers.
sections.faq:
Is the free plugin limited by time or booking quantity?

No. Core booking features do not expire and have no appointment quota.

Are paid add-ons hidden inside this plugin?

No. Optional commercial functionality is distributed as separately installed add-on plugins. The free plugin contains only normal extension hooks and filters needed for interoperability.

Does the plugin contact ThemeKaddora automatically?

No. The product website opens only when an administrator clicks an Upgrade link.

Are pages published automatically?

No. Recommended pages are created only after an administrator chooses the onboarding action, and they are created as drafts.

What personal information is stored?

A booking may store the customer’s name, email address, telephone number, appointment details, notes, consent choices, and related operational metadata. The plugin provides WordPress privacy exporter and eraser integrations.

1.0.1

  • Fixed the WordPress.org text-domain mismatch by using the assigned plugin slug consistently.
  • Restored reliable administrator access to the top-level Appointments menu.
  • Positioned the Appointments menu directly below Settings in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  • Corrected dashboard, onboarding, cron, and Upgrade submenu URLs to use the assigned plugin slug.
